seg: Tonight we're in Acts chapter two, and I've called this message When the Wind Came.
The Spirit comes and the disciples speak in other tongues.
Peter stands up with the eleven and raises his voice.
He explains this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel.

section.heading: The Spirit comes with power
bullets: Wind and fire fill the house at Pentecost
All are filled and speak in other tongues
Peter stands to explain what is happening

seg: It reminds me of a storm when I was a boy on my grandfather's farm, when the wind tore the roof off the barn and we stood there amazed at how powerful it was.
Then Peter preaches Jesus, crucified and raised, now Lord and Christ.
The people are cut to the heart and ask what they should do.
Peter answers in Acts 2 verse 38, repent and be baptized.

summary.title: When the Wind Came

section.heading: Peter preaches the risen Christ
bullets: Jesus crucified and raised is now Lord and Christ
The crowd is cut to the heart and asks what to do
Acts 2:38 - repent and be baptized for forgiveness

illustrations: The pastor recalled a boyhood storm on his grandfather's farm that tore the barn roof off, as a picture of the Spirit's unstoppable power.

seg: This is grace, the same grace Paul describes in Ephesians 2 verse 8.
About three thousand were added that day and the church devoted itself to teaching and prayer.

summary.title: When the Wind Came

section.heading: The church is born
bullets: Salvation is by grace through faith, Ephesians 2:8
Three thousand are added to the church that day
The believers devote themselves to teaching, fellowship, and prayer
